**Volume confound ruled out (step_01, step_02):** group event counts are flat across all six sub-windows (200, 197, 147, 152, 175, 222) — no burst or dropout. Per-node degrees are also stable across the boundary (step_03 vs step_04: ~8–12 partners each side). So any change is in partner *identity*, not activity level.

**Partner identity turnover (steps 05–08), node 1936:**

| Window pair | Overlap | Jaccard |
|---|---|---|

| [12551,17551] vs [17551,22551] (**across**) | **0 shared** | **0.00** |
| [17551,22551] vs [22551,27551] (within new) | 8 shared {160,350,861,871,945,1088,1884} + | ~0.62 |

The contact set is highly persistent *inside* each regime but **completely disjoint across the ~17551 boundary**. Gradual background turnover would produce a similar moderate decay at every step; instead the overlap collapses to exactly zero at a single boundary and recovers immediately after. That is the signature of an abrupt regime switch, not drift.
